fields.PRODUCT NAME: Royal Elephant Miniature Painting on Marble – Framed Rajasthani Artwork
fields.DESCRIPTION: Bring home a piece of royal Rajasthan with this exquisite Royal Elephant Miniature Painting on Marble. Hand-painted by skilled artisans, this artwork captures a majestic elephant adorned in traditional royal attire, symbolizing prosperity, power, and grace. Set against a floral and architectural backdrop, the painting is delicately rendered on a polished marble tile, enhancing its elegance and longevity.
